raw_user_query: explain step-by-step how a simple electric circuit is built and all the main components of a circuit

orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: explain how to build a simple electric circuit and its main components

scenes.teacher_script: This lesson will explain how to build a simple electric circuit and identify its main components.

scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To visually represent the components of a circuit.
scenes.teacher_script: A simple electric circuit consists of several main components: a power source, wires, a switch, and a load (like a bulb).

scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To show the steps in a cyclical manner.
scenes.teacher_script: To build a simple circuit, follow these steps: 1. Connect the positive terminal of the battery to one end of the switch. 2. Connect the other end of the switch to one terminal of the bulb. 3. Connect the other terminal of the bulb back to the negative terminal of the battery.
Now you know how to build a simple electric circuit and the main components involved. Practice building your own circuit!
